Thats because sweating is actually a super important way for your body to detox and so something that keeps you from sweating is very unhealthy.  so that to say as far as smell goes this really works!!  i sometimes reapply a second t

reviews.t: No fakes: Two different basic ingredient lists, one regular, one "sensitive"
reviews.x: There's been some distress recently over supposed fakes or the ingredients being changed, but it appears they aren't fake and haven't changed.  I checked in the Wayback Machine, and the ingredients for the one I checked (Coconut & Vanilla) were the same at the Native website on January 2, 2019 as they are now.  The confusion is that there are two different versions, one regular and one called "sensitive," for several of the same scents (including Coconut & Vanilla), and they have very different

Native makes some of the best natural deodorants on the market. They're just as effective as the drugstore brands. I like this set because you get three different scents. My favorite is the peony. The scents are all fresh and light. They won't clash with other fragrances you wear. This set is perfect for gifting. I highly recommend it.  Thanks so much for taking the time to read this review. I hope the information that I've provided makes your decision a little easier.

reviews.t: Satisfied customer for more than 3 years
reviews.x: I began using this over 3 years ago.  I haven't purchased directly from Amazon yet as I have a subscription and it is delivered to me every 4 months.  That is how long one container lasts me.  I do use this every day.  I felt compelled to write this after reading some poor reviews.  When I first started using I too had a slight rash - I think it was my body getting adjusted to Native.  It went away and has never come back.  I use the Coconut Vanilla.  For those people saying that they felt they

reviews.t: Get it, but know how to use it.
reviews.x: I wanted to clarify something for those people who think this deodorant (or other natural brands) doesn't work. It works 100% BUT you cannot, cannot, CAN NOT go straight from an aluminum-containing deodorant to a non-aluminum deodorant. If you've been using deodorants with aluminum, you MUST do an underarm detox using either bentonite clay or a charcoal mask otherwise any natural deodorants you try WILL NOT WORK. You have to use bentonite clay to pull the toxins out of you skin. It will smell ba

I was soo excited!!! I’ve been looking for a natural deodorant and I thought I found it when I found this one. It worked okay for the first two days but my underarms felt a little irritated, gliding and sliding..... I continued use and I ended up with a rash on both arms, it was really bad. I’m so saddened. Other deodorants don’t do this. And as for order, I can’t necessarily speak on that fully since my arms have a rash and I have to be gentle with bathing them.. so maybe if and when this rash

reviews.t: Wonderful scents and glides on smoothly.
reviews.x: This deodorant goes on smoothly and has a wonderful scent.  This is not antiperspirant, it is deodorant.  There is no aluminum to cause issues and once your body adjusts to "life without antiperspirant" this deodorant works great!  For me the adjustment took about two weeks.  Very little product is needed to work effectively,  just one or two swipes and you're good to go.
would suggest this product for those looking for high quality clean healthy products.

reviews.t: The Best Aluminum Free Deodorant-Prefer Native Unscented But Their Scented Works Great Too
reviews.x: I’ve been using Native unscented deodorant for a couple years, and it’s my favorite aluminum free deodorant. I’ve been trying a 3-pack of full size scented Native deodorant sticks in Peony & Jasmine Tea, Sweet Almond & Honey and Linen & Cotton varieties. The Peony is a citrusy floral scent, and the Linen one smells crisp and fresh. The Sweet Almond smells a little sweet like honey and has a light coconut scent. I especially like the Peony and Linen scents as they work best with my chemistry, but

reviews.x: I tried really hard for a really long time to find a deodorant that was both zero waste AND vegan/cruelty free/environmentally conscious - but that also did it’s job and deodorized. I’m still looking for that perfect product, but while I’m waiting, Native easily comes in at number two. I love the scents, it lasts all day long, and has a really pretty package. Obviously it’s vegan and environmentally conscious, too. With all we know about the recycling industry these days, the only thing that cou

When you switch from a deodorant like Secret to an all natural deodorant you will stink ‼️ That’s the process ‼️ Please take your deodorant everywhere you go‼️ This is the best natural deodorant there is ‼️Unless you made your own ( and I do ) when I switch two years ago !! I got a rash ( I was using Arm and Hammer all natural ( don’t buy that brand in my opinion ) this deodorant is the best ‼️ No irritation to the skin , smell amazing ‼️  Very expensive but it last way longer than the cheap kin

I’ve been wanting to switch to a natural, aluminum free deodorant for a while and upon shopping around Native was recommended quite a bit. I took another user’s advice to do a clay mask before using to kind of detox the skin and I think that helped the transition. I mostly bought this set for the peony scent, thinking I wouldn’t care too much for the others. I ended up loving them all so much. I alternate scents depending on the day and they all work (and smell) equally amazing. I will definitel

reviews.t: Long lasting and great for sensitivity
reviews.x: First off, LOVE THIS DEODERANT! I have used Native for some time now and have discovered that certain scents last a long time and others last maybe a few hours. If you sweat a lot and are prone to heavy B.O., I don’t recommend the lighter scents like vanilla and coconut or mints for sensitive skin. I wasn’t a huge fan of the fresh linen scent but the others are phenomenal and last all day. Highly recommend!!! Especially since it’s natural ingredients and no aluminum is a plus in my book any day!

All deodorants I used would only work for a small time period like a couple weeks and then just not be sufficient forcing me to look for a new type. Also there would be residue, as in I would shower but old deodorant would still remain as much as I scrubbed. This deodorant does none of that and it’s been about a year or more & still works. Love it it’s my favorite deodorant that actually works, is safe, and smells amazing. So many different scents to choose from.

I love native because the scents are out of this world and have been effective.  However, after a year i developed an allergic reaction that made my skin purple and itchy.  I went to dermatologist and she said she's been seeing a lot of cases like mine related to Native deodorant products.  I was such a fan of the product i bought multiples at one time, now have to dispose of them.  So, if you're thinking about buying multiples....just a word of caution.

I have only let my teen use deoderants due to health concerns.  I like the ingredients on this product and felt confident in ordering it for her.  The true test came when it arrived - would my picky teen agree to use it?  YES!  She loves 1 sent and said the other 2 are "ok".  That is high praise from her.  Several weeks after starting to use it, I've heard 0 complaints.  From a kid who complains about everything, this is excellent indeed!

This stuff is amazing. I’ve been using “prescription strength” deodorant for as long as I can remember. With those, it started out ok, but inevitably by end of day I’m still sweaty, smelly and now have god knows what seeped into my pores. This stuff smells amazing- I have tried the vanilla/coconut, eucalyptus and now the linen scent- they’re all absolutely delicious and keep me from sweating and smelling all day. Can’t recommend enough.

I've been using this deodorant for about a year now and have converted just about everyone I know to it.  I'm pretty sensitive to most deodorants and antiperspirants. This one however does not cause any irritation to my skin at all.  It's a deodorant, so it won't stop you from sweating. It does however stop odor. It's the only "deodorant" I've used since Adidas deodorant that does so.  My only complaint is I wish it was cheaper!

reviews.t: Best natural deodorant on the market
reviews.x: Wife's review.... In our household this is the best natural deodorant on the market. This is the only brand that keeps me smelling fresh all day long. All of the scents in this pack are lovely, however Peony and Jasmine tea is my favorite. I borrowed my husbands Citrus and herbal musk and that specific scent type did break me out slightly. I've never had any issues prior to pregnancy with skin sensitivity and these deodorants.

I ordered 'Native Deodorant - Natural Deodorant - 3 Pack Seasonal' for review.  this set comes with three different scents  Each scent is light and not overpowering.  The deodorant is soft and goes on smoothly.  My wife, who has to use an extra strength deodorant has been pleased with the odor control.  Her sensitive skin has no issues with this deodorant.  Overall a great natural product.  I hope this review was helpful!

reviews.t: It has no hidden ingredients to harm your health
reviews.x: I use it for deodorant because that is what it is. It is somewhat of a waxy type deodorant so I warm it up with my hair dryer and it goes on smoother. Also I wish there was a way you could use what is left in container once it has been rolled up as far as it will go, as you really do throw a good portion away that you cannot get out. Other than those two issues I love it, it works very well doing its job!!

Yes! Here we go! As you can see, I made a commitment, while Amazon was offering a deal, to buy six varieties of this deodorant. I have known about aluminum and other things which are harmful to us. Somehow I did not know about these this product until now. Maybe I didn't look because I tried others years ago and was disappointed. So I will try to keep you informed and appraised as I begin this journey.

I wanted to try this natural deodorant because I saw a list of best natural deodorants, and this brand was on it. The scents smell great. However, after using it one time, I noticed my skin color had changed. I thought maybe it was just the color of the deodorant on my skin and that after taking a shower, it would scrub off. It did not wash off. I will stick to Arm and Hammer Essentials deodorant.

reviews.t: Love this deodorant but had some black hairs in the package
reviews.x: Usually purchase a different trio from a different vendor but the ones I normally get were currently unavailable so I decided on these. They smell good and I love native deodorant but when I opened the box there was little black hairs almost like shaved beard hairs. Luckily the inside was still in good condition so I just cloroxed the outside but still a little gross.

I absolutely love this deodorant! I’ve tried a few natural deodorants, but this one has been the best by far! I’ve bought several different scents and I have yet to find a scent that doesn’t smell good. It’s not an antiperspirant, but I wasn’t looking for that. I was looking for a natural deodorant that works and smells good all day and this brand definitely is that!

claims.text: Most reviewers find it effective as a natural deodorant, often comparing it favorably to drugstore brands.
Reviewers praise the scents as fresh, light, and pleasant, with some noting certain scents last longer than others.
Several reviewers note a transition period when switching from aluminum-based deodorants, during which odor or irritation may occur.
Some users report skin irritation or rashes, including one who developed an allergic reaction after a year of use.
Reviewers confirm the product is aluminum-free and note it does not stop sweating, as it is a deodorant rather than an antiperspirant.
